description: Chemical equation balancer — Balance any chemical equation exactly (rational null-space solver, not guessing): ions with charges (Fe^3+, MnO4^-, e^-), brackets, hydrates (CuSO4.5H2O). Returns the balanced equation, integer coefficients, per-element atom check, molar masses and a mass-conservation check; flags equations that mix independent reactions. Param equation= (use -> or =; separate species with +). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_balance
